errors.evidence: The description omits the unit for the y-axis, which is percentage (%).
The description incorrectly states that the green line for Österreich (Austria) has triangle markers. In the figure, the green line has circle markers.
The description states that the line for Austria starts at 0.50 in 2000, but the figure shows it starting at approximately 0.25.
The description invents a data point for the year 2003, which is not labeled on the axis. It also incorrectly states the line sinks, when in fact it rises after 2000.
The description claims the value for Austria in 2015 is 1.75. The figure shows this value is approximately 1.30.
The description incorrectly states that the blue line for Deutschland (Germany) has circular markers. In the figure, the blue line has triangle markers.
The description invents a data point for Germany in 2003, stating the value is -0.25. The line is actually positive at that time (around +0.3) and never reaches -0.25.
The description states the value for Germany in 2005 is 0.50, but the figure shows it is approximately 0.1.
The description claims the line for Germany falls to 0.25 in 2010. The line is actually rising towards 2010, and the value is approximately 0.20.
The description stops at the year 2020 and completely omits the final data points, which show a sharp increase in net migration for both countries after 2020.
